title: Analytical methods for biomarker-based diagnosis of pulpitis in minimally invasive biological fluids: a systematic review
html: Inflammatory biomarkers measured in minimally invasive biological fluids are promising objective tools for diagnosing pulpitis. However, the analytical methods used to detect and quantify these biomarkers, and their diagnostic performance, have not been critically evaluated. This review aimed to identify and assess the analytical methods for detecting and quantifying inflammatory biomarkers in gingival crevicular fluid, dentinal fluid and pulpal blood to distinguish healthy pulp from different stages of pulpitis.
